info.name: Retrieves the merchant orders. Allows filtering of the orders by creation and modified date.

params.name: merchant-id
params.description: To identify a merchant for which this operation is carried out.

params.name: include
params.description: Comma separated field names to be included. Allowed fields: order_transitions, order_items, order_lines, order_lines.order_line_transitions, shipments

params.name: page[number]
params.description: Pagination page number.

params.name: page[size]
params.description: Limit the number of results (per page).

params.name: sort
params.description: Sorting fields separated by comma. Default order is Ascending (ASC), minus(-) should be used in front of field name for Descending (DESC) order.

params.name: sales_channel_id
params.description: Query filter specifying a sales channel.

params.name: created_after
params.description: All orders created after the given timestamp (exclusive). The timestamp is in the ISO 8601 format. The Date and time are separated by the "T" literal, and the Time and Timezone are separated by the "+" literal. For UTC time, you should simply use "Z" as the suffix, for other cases use URL encoding for the "+" literal.

params.name: created_before
params.description: All orders created before the given timestamp (exclusive). The timestamp is in the ISO 8601 format. The Date and time are separated by the "T" literal, and the Time and Timezone are separated by the "+" literal. For UTC time, you should simply use "Z" as the suffix, for other cases use URL encoding for the "+" literal.

params.name: last_updated_after
params.description: All orders updated after the given timestamp (exclusive). The timestamp is in the ISO 8601 format. The Date and time are separated by the "T" literal, and the Time and Timezone are separated by the "+" literal. For UTC time, you should simply use "Z" as the suffix, for other cases use URL encoding for the "+" literal.

params.name: last_updated_before
params.description: All orders updated before the given timestamp (exclusive). The timestamp is in the ISO 8601 format. The Date and time are separated by the "T" literal, and the Time and Timezone are separated by the "+" literal. For UTC time, you should simply use "Z" as the suffix, for other cases use URL encoding for the "+" literal.

params.name: order_status
params.description: All orders of a given status (possible values are defined in OrderStatus definition).

params.name: order_number
params.description: Exact Zalando order number to filter against.

params.name: locale
params.description: All orders sold in the locale.

params.name: exported
params.description: Filter orders that have already been exported or not.

params.name: order_type
params.description: All orders of a given type (possible values are: PartnerFulfilled, ZalandoFulfilled).

items.docs: Retrieves all the orders for the merchant that match the query parameters given. The retention period for orders data is 1 year. All the orders older than this period are not accessible in this endpoint. The response displays all the relevant information for each order.

items.docs: Updates a shipment object in preparation for shipping the order. A shipment represents the specific order lines that will be shipped together and plays a central role in the fulfillment process. All shipment fields can be updated except the order line IDs, it is not allowed to add or remove order lines from an existing shipment
